tagline: 禄来胶片相机，1949 年发布
description: 禄来于1949年推出的胶片相机。配备Carl Zeiss Tessar 1:3.5 f=75mm, Coated. or : Zeiss Oberkochen Opton Tessar 1:3.5 f=75mm, Coated. or : Schneider-Kreuznach Xenar 1:3.5 f=75mm, Coated.。快门速度Compur-Rapid X CR00 leafshutter. Speeds 1 to 1/500 sec. and B.。使用12 exposures of 6 x 6 cm on 120 type rollfilm. Furthermore a Plate adapter for sheet film and a Rolleikin adapter for 35mm film cartridges can be used.。

specs.胶片/画幅: 12 exposures of 6 x 6 cm on 120 type rollfilm. Furthermore a Plate adapter for sheet film and a Rolleikin adapter for 35mm film cartridges can be used.
specs.镜头: Carl Zeiss Tessar 1:3.5 f=75mm, Coated. or : Zeiss Oberkochen Opton Tessar 1:3.5 f=75mm, Coated. or : Schneider-Kreuznach Xenar 1:3.5 f=75mm, Coated.
specs.快门: Compur-Rapid X CR00 leafshutter. Speeds 1 to 1/500 sec. and B.
specs.闪光灯: Sync socket on frontpanel. X synchronization
specs.英文简介: Soon after the end of WWII Franke & Heidecke started further improvements of their hugely succesfull 6x6 Automat series.
